mapper.select: SELECT x.id, x.no, x.prd_order_id, p.no AS prd_order_no, p.kind, p.style_id, s.name AS style_name, x.issue_type, x.description, x.create_by, x.create_time FROM prd_issue x JOIN prd_order p ON p.id = x.prd_order_id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE x.status <> 'CLOSED' AND p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND (p.create_by = #{scope.userId} OR p.merch_id = #{scope.userId}) AND p.merch_id = #{merchId} ORDER BY x.create_time, x.id
